Pallavi Sinha | pallavi.sinha313@example.com | +91 9493092091
Mumbai

Professional Summary
Detail-oriented accounting professional with experience across banking and IT services environments. Proven track record in managing accounts payable processes, GST compliance, and maintaining financial records using Tally. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel for reconciliations and reporting. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
Tally, GST, Accounts Payable, Microsoft Excel, Git, Jira

Work Experience

Senior Accountant, Saffron Bank (Jan 2026 - Present)
- Managed end-to-end Accounts Payable cycle for vendor payments, reducing invoice processing time by 28% through streamlined approvals and workflow tracking using Jira.
- Prepared and filed monthly GST returns and reconciliations, identifying and correcting discrepancies that recovered INR 2.1M in input tax credits; maintained all entries in Tally.
- Created Excel-based dashboards to monitor payables aging and cash flow forecasts, improving accuracy of short-term liquidity planning.

Accounts Manager, Wipro (Nov 2020 - Dec 2025)
- Led Accounts Payable team handling high-volume vendor invoices, implemented process controls that decreased late payment penalties by 35%; tracked tasks and SLAs using Jira.
- Oversaw GST compliance across multiple service lines, coordinated with tax consultants to ensure timely filings and audit readiness; maintained ledgers in Tally.
- Developed advanced Microsoft Excel models for month-end close, variance analysis, and vendor reconciliations, reducing reconciliation time by 40%.
- Used Git to version-control procedural documentation and Excel macros to ensure consistency in reporting templates.

Accountant, Infosys (Dec 2014 - Oct 2020)
- Processed Accounts Payable transactions for global vendor base, maintained accurate supplier ledgers and supported month-end closing activities.
- Maintained accounting records and prepared routine reports in Tally, ensuring ledger accuracy and timely invoice matching.
- Assisted in GST-related data preparation and basic filing support, contributing to smoother quarterly compliances.

Education
B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
